import json, torch

configure();torch.manual_seed(43)
a=(torch.randn(5,3,3)*.05).requires_grad_();b=torch.randn(5,3,requires_grad=True)

 p=dict(m.named_parameters())[name];analytic=float(p.grad[index]);original=float(p[index]);values=[]
 for sign in (1,-1):
  with torch.no_grad():p[index]=original+sign*1e-6;values.append(float(m(x,q,base).square().mean()))
 with torch.no_grad():p[index]=original
 numeric=(values[0]-values[1])/2e-6
 rows.append(dict(parameter=name,index=index,analytic=analytic,numeric=numeric,absolute_error=abs(analytic-numeric)))
